profile.overview: Alisa is a fast and evasive poking character who excels at darting around her opponent while peppering them quick moves. Her strong movement allows her to gracefully step around her opponent's attacks, making it difficult to pin her down. On the offense, her frustrating array of pokes can whittle down an opponent or provoke them into doing something stupid. She can also mixup her opponent with dual chainsaws, that in Heat, will quickly rip apart an opponent's grey life. She's great for players looking to play a fast, hit-and-run playstyle that emphasizes movement.
strengths: Pokes are quick, have good range, and are safe or difficult to punish
Excellent basic movement with sidesteps, sidewalks, and backdashes all being among the best
Features a highly accessible baseline execution
weaknesses: Pokes have low damage; she struggles on a life deficit
Most of her primary poking tools and flying stance transitions are heavily linear, you can consistently shut down her approach by sidestepping or side-walking to her right (SSR)
Many of her primary strings and pressure tools rely on a high-hitting second extension that can be easily ducked and launch-punished
Bigger comeback tools like DES.d+2 are slow
heat: Increased chip damage when chainsaw attacks are blocked
New Dual Boot shift moves can be used (H.f+1+4, f+2,1,H.3_4)
New power-up Destructive Form shift moves can be used (H.d+1+2, f,F+2,H.1+2)
